text_block_list.text: One day, while out with Still in Love—

Looking in the direction Still in Love pointed,
there was a claw machine filled with
plushies modeled after Umamusume.

text_block_list.name: Still in Love
text_block_list.text: Umm... is this what they call Paka Petit?

text_block_list.name: Still in Love
text_block_list.text:
No... but it does look fun.
Though I'm not very used to
these kinds of games...
choice_data_list: Wanna have a little fun before heading home?

text_block_list.name: Still in Love
text_block_list.text:
Are you sure about this?
Ah... Wait, Trainer...
Is there a Paka Petit you want...?

text_block_list.name: Still in Love
text_block_list.text:
N-No, not at all...!
...N-Now then, let us be on our way.

text_block_list.name: Still in Love
text_block_list.text:
I'll be rooting for you.
...May it bring a good result.
—I can't afford to lose this game!!
